test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

U @ H means 'U is the son of H',

U % H means 'U is the daughter of H',

U & H means 'U is the mother of H',

U # H means 'U is the father of H'.

If N % M # R @ L & K, then how is N related to K?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 @
 %
 &
 #
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Daughter
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: N % M # R @ L & K

It means: N is the Daughter of M, M is the Father of R, R is the Son of L, L is the Mother of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0a033a0d1a71270d6eceefbdf568a2ab436ad41ef94b0d7d3525e4cfc84b1ab.png] 

So, N is the '**Sister**' of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
